name: io.github.shibbirweb/mcp-db-read-only
title: Databases (read-only, switchable)
description: Read-only SQL, MongoDB, Redis and Elasticsearch access, switchable mid-conversation.

environmentVariables.name: DB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Connection URL to open at startup, e.g. postgres://user@host:5432/db, mongodb://user@host/db, redis://host:6379/0 or sqlite:///data/app.db

environmentVariables.name: DB_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for DB_URL, so it need not be percent-encoded inside the URL

environmentVariables.name: DB_PROFILES
environmentVariables.description: JSON object of named connections to switch between, each a URL or {"url", "password"}

environmentVariables.name: DB_DEFAULT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which DB_PROFILES entry to start on

environmentVariables.name: DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000

environmentVariables.name: DB_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Server-side query timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Legacy MySQL-only form, kept for drop-in compatibility. Prefer DB_URL

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_USER
environmentVariables.description: Legacy MySQL-only form. Prefer DB_URL

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Legacy MySQL-only form. Prefer DB_URL with DB_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy MySQL-only form. Prefer DB_URL
